high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a selfie in what appears to be a dressing room or a similar indoor setting. The individual is wearing a traditional Indian outfit, specifically a blouse with intricate floral embroidery in shades of blue, red, and green on a dark background. The blouse has short sleeves and a fitted design that accentuates the waist. Over the blouse, there is a navy blue dupatta (a type of scarf) draped over one shoulder. The person is also wearing a statement necklace with large, dark beads that complement the outfit.
